visualCharacteristics: Horizontally-scrolling gallery of tall image cards with a client eyebrow and title overlaid on a dark gradient. Filled light-grey round prev/next arrows (red on hover, dimmed at the ends) scroll one card at a time. rounded: 24px card corners. arrows-right: arrows at the bottom right. heading-left: the section heading in a 345px left column with the arrows at its bottom, cards to the right (desktop).
contentPattern: First row labels the block ('Cards'). Each case study is one row with two cells: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = client eyebrow + title (heading) + optional link.
usage: 'Our work in action' case-study / client-story gallery carousel.
